messages.content:
I have this list of names and I need them formatted as 'Lastname, Firstname'. 
John Smith
Jane Doe
Bob Jones
Alice Wonderland

There is a satisfying rhythm to inverting names like this; it lends the text a sense of archival order. Here is your list, transformed with the surnames leading the way:

Smith, John
Doe, Jane
Jones, Bob
Wonderland, Alice

I trust this arrangement serves your purpose well.
